Delighted to announce our upcoming series of four deep dive webinars exploring practical implementation of our recently launched 'UNDP Energy Governance Framework for a Just Energy Transition'. 
Join us for the first webinar focusing on the pivotal role of institutions, where esteemed panelists will discuss topics like building competence, strengthening collaboration, promoting inclusivity, and balancing short-term needs with long-term goals, along with some inspiring country examples!

📅 When - 28th March 2024 
⏱️ Time - 11.00 AM New York
